transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We've got a two-day readiness cycle coming up and I need to get the sustainment-training schedule locked in. The four lanes are fuel-accountability, vehicle-dispatch, communications-procedure, and medical-logistics. Each platoon attends only one lane, and each lane is used by only one platoon. Before I publish the final schedule, I'd like us to synchronize as we normally do. Let's hear from the training, motor transport, signal, and medical logistics leads on support requirements and any constraints we need to be aware of. Who wants to start?
